знать.text:
Inherited from Old East Slavic знати (znati), from Proto-Slavic *znati, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *źnōˀtei, from Proto-Indo-European *ǵnéh₃t (“to know, get to know”), from *ǵneh₃-.
The relation of this word to зна́ти (znáty, “to know”) was from mediaeval Slavic nobility being noteworthy for their higher social status.
